title: UTC report identities and preserved archives
author: Bijan Mousavi
why: Sort engineering evidence by actual UTC preparation time without changing the identities or bytes of historical reports.
what: Require timestamped report IDs, calendar and preparation agreement. Rename three existing triplets and add explicit validated legacy lookup.
how: Bind new IDs to preparation UTC. Preserve archive bytes and original trailers; verify their hashes, original trees and parent-bound fingerprints. A corrected wrong-commit test retains its failed run.
preserved: All nine legacy artifacts retain original bytes, records, preparation times and trailers. Application, dependencies, adapters, deployment and existing CI inputs are unchanged.
risk: Historical records require original tools for reproduction. Archive lookup depends on available original ancestry. It cannot authorize a new legacy-ID candidate.
limitations: 57 report tests passed on the exported index. No application behavior, viewer decoding, remote CI or deployment claim. Prior known audit advisories remain.
rollback: Revert this coherent change with a new report. Restore original archive paths and tools together; retain authored historical commits and their evidence.

checks.command: git diff --cached --exit-code HEAD -- src public package.json package-lock.json astro.config.mjs netlify.toml tsconfig.json Dockerfile helm-chart .github .dockerignore
